result.reason: The affiliate and successor carve-outs for Customer are appropriate, and no Vendor termination right is added. However, the clause does not absolutely prohibit IBM from assigning to a Customer competitor; it permits such an assignment with Customer consent and may subject withholding that consent to the reasonableness standard. This conflicts with the preferred position and with the margin comment’s claim. It also unnecessarily changes the original continuing-liability provision from Customer-only to mutual, imposing a new obligation on IBM that is not required by the playbook.
